# ssp_upgrade_history (Data Source)

Lists past upgrade execution history for the SSP platform.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/upgrade/history`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `history` (Attributes List) List of past upgrade execution records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))

<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>

### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `current_step` (String) Current step at completion.
- `id` (String) Upgrade record ID.
- `status` (String) Final or current status.
- `target_version` (String) Target version of the upgrade.
